item.title: Submit
item.description: Please use this google form for submitting your scores to leaderboard. Submission Guidelines # Researchers can submit their model results for single as well as multiple tasks. The submission can have different models for multiple tasks or the same model for multiple tasks. The submission instrctions are provided in the form itself. The submission to the leaderboard requires of the following: A link to the model code A link to the model weights A link to the model predictions on the test set A link to the model predictions on the dev set (if available) A published paper (if available)
